result.title: ShapeQuest: Towards Granularity-Controlled Edit-Conditioned 3D Asset Retrieval
result.summary: Given a reference asset and an instruction such as "remove one armrest," a retriever must find variants that make the edit and preserve the other parts. This search is well established for images but remains underexplored for individual 3D assets. To study this problem, we introduce ShapeQuest and ShapeQuester, a new benchmark and model for edit-conditioned 3D asset retrieval. ShapeQuest's open-source pipeline edits textured meshes through part additions, removals, and material and colour changes. It controls edit granularity across five levels, defined by the fraction of the object's surface area each edit affects. It constructs multiple valid targets when an instruction leaves the choice of part open. A vision-language model judges each edit from views chosen to expose the edited parts, and human raters audit its judgments. ShapeQuest has 87,824 queries in 50 categories and a 50,919-shape gallery with competing edits. To distinguish these variants, ShapeQuester learns retrieval alongside reconstruction of the edited point cloud, with part masks supervising changed and preserved regions. With a frozen pretrained point encoder, ShapeQuester reaches 50.4 operation-macro mAP@10 on the test split, against 47.2 for the fusion baseline with the same inputs and 48.6 for the strongest baseline. Reconstruction adds 6.5 points on the validation split when the point encoder is trained from scratch, including 3.3 from part masks.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 ShapeQuest 基准与 ShapeQuester 模型，研究指令式编辑条件下的单个 3D 资产检索：按受影响表面积划分五级编辑粒度，用 VLM 从特定视角判分并由人工审核，模型联合检索与重建被编辑点云，并以部位掩码监督变化与保留区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线关联较远，但其按粒度分级的编辑构造和「部位掩码区分变化/保留区域」的监督方式，可能为检验 latent 是否保留细粒度视觉细节、以及分层粒度评价提供可核查的参照。
